text:
What Just Happened, Kimi?

Laila Khawaja, Arthur Kroeber, Tom Hancock

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 27 Jul 2026

The US tech world spent much of the past 10 days freaking out over the latest high-performance Chinese AI model release, Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3. This once again conjured the specter of cheap open-weight Chinese models blowing up the revenue engines for their more costly American competitors. Shortly afterwards, Chinese open models went from villain to hero, as the US-based developer community Hugging Face used a Chinese model to fend off a rogue cyber attack by an OpenAI model.
